newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica call rates to be set Apr 3-press.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica call rates to be set Apr 3-press.

text.p: Spain's Development Ministry will propose on April 3 an around 11 percent cut in Telefonica's long distance call rates, financial daily Expansion reported on Tuesday.

The measure will be accompanied by a calendar for tariff cuts from March 1998, including a further 15 percent fall in long distance rates. Provincial calls are to be cut five percent from that point, while international calls will fall 12 percent.
At the same time local rates will rise, as well as monthly telephone service rates.
The report said these new rates will be specified in a ministerial document, due to be published on April 3.
No-one at the Development Ministry was available to comment.
